verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Sentry serves llms.txt at docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its docs pages are also published as agent-friendly .md files (e.g. /ai/agent-plugin.md, /product/agents.md). Beyond that, Sentry ships agent-oriented guidance: a one-command plugin that teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok to set up Sentry, dotagents skill packaging, and an MCP server that can read documentation. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully using llms.txt, and evidence of the llms.txt content's depth and coverage beyond its header.
